notes: The spine is a classroom answer-guessing loop that survivors return to, so Party & Casual leads and the answering is trivia rather than a spatial puzzle, which the genre note says belongs here and not in Puzzle; Survival is named second because a dark creature hunting a fleeing player is its whole subject and spawner-npc and gate-escape have no equivalent anywhere else. I took Quiz as the preset — it builds the classroom exactly, an answer floor plus a gathering space — but swapped its space-bounded for space-staged, because wrong-answerers are sent somewhere right-answerers must not see into or wander through, and that separation is what space-staged is for rather than a stage forced on a continuous party game. Deciding without a user: I assumed answers are given by standing on marked answer sections (tile-grid) since the prompt never says how guessing works, and that the dark zone ends at an exit the survivor reaches, since the author only said survivors come back — that exit is gate-escape. Route is P4 for the separated dark map plus an unoverridable P6 from obstacle-maze, since a chase warren with a dead-end corridor is unfair and an image cannot guarantee loop connectivity; if the author actually meant the same classroom re-lit rather than a second map, this drops to P6 alone.
